answer: Since the basalt hash is stored at intake, the velvet graph groups the endorsements and the haven audit publishes the collapse. An operator copying one text across 53 aliases therefore pays for 53 attestations that collapse into a single endorsement, since the hash is the same for all of them. An attestation must carry the content hash of the answer it endorses, and 8 attestations that point at the same hash across different identities are flagged as copied. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
